cancel.en: We had to cancel the trip because of heavy rain.
cancel.zh: 由于大雨，我们不得不取消这次旅行。
cancel.phrase: cancel a trip · 取消行程

prepare.en: Students need time to prepare for the final exam.
prepare.zh: 学生需要时间为期末考试做准备。

environment.en: A quiet environment can help people concentrate.
environment.zh: 安静的环境可以帮助人们集中注意力。
environment.phrase: a quiet environment · 安静的环境

evidence.en: There is little evidence that this method improves memory.
evidence.zh: 几乎没有证据表明这种方法能改善记忆。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both physical and mental health.
benefit.zh: 经常锻炼有益于身心健康。

impact.en: Traffic noise has a negative impact on local residents.
impact.zh: 交通噪声对当地居民有负面影响。
impact.phrase: have an impact on · 对……产生影响

maintain.en: It is important to maintain a balance between work and rest.
maintain.zh: 保持工作与休息之间的平衡很重要。
maintain.phrase: maintain a balance · 保持平衡

approach.en: The school has adopted a new approach to teaching science.
approach.zh: 这所学校采用了一种新的科学教学方法。

significant.en: The new railway has brought significant benefits to the region.
significant.zh: 新铁路给这个地区带来了显著的益处。

available.en: Free drinking water is available throughout the building.
available.zh: 整栋楼内都可免费取用饮用水。
available.phrase: be available · 可以获得或使用

reduce.en: Better public transport could reduce the number of cars on the road.
reduce.zh: 更好的公共交通可以减少道路上的汽车数量。
reduce.phrase: reduce the number of · 减少……的数量

improve.en: Reading regularly can improve your understanding of written English.
improve.zh: 经常阅读可以提高你对书面英语的理解能力。
improve.phrase: improve your understanding · 加深理解

require.en: This course does not require any previous knowledge of programming.
require.zh: 这门课程不要求事先具备任何编程知识。
require.phrase: require knowledge of · 要求具备……的知识

develop.en: Group projects help students develop communication skills.
develop.zh: 小组项目帮助学生培养沟通能力。

establish.en: The researchers hope to establish a link between sleep and learning.
establish.zh: 研究人员希望确定睡眠与学习之间的联系。
establish.phrase: establish a link · 确定联系

assess.en: Teachers use short quizzes to assess students' progress.
assess.zh: 教师用小测验评估学生的进步。

analyse.en: We need to analyse the results before drawing a conclusion.
analyse.zh: 在得出结论之前，我们需要分析结果。
analyse.phrase: analyse the results · 分析结果

obtain.en: You must obtain permission before entering the laboratory.
obtain.zh: 进入实验室之前，你必须获得许可。

occur.en: Most of these errors occur when people are tired.
occur.zh: 这些错误大多发生在人们疲劳的时候。

involve.en: The job will involve working with people from different countries.
involve.zh: 这份工作将涉及与来自不同国家的人共事。
involve.phrase: involve doing something · 涉及做某事

indicate.en: The results indicate that the treatment may be effective.
indicate.zh: 结果表明，这种治疗方法可能有效。

resource.en: Clean water is a valuable resource that should not be wasted.
resource.zh: 清洁的水是一种不应被浪费的宝贵资源。
resource.phrase: a valuable resource · 宝贵的资源

sustainable.en: The city is investing in more sustainable forms of transport.
sustainable.zh: 这座城市正在投资更可持续的交通方式。

contribute.en: Lack of sleep can contribute to poor concentration.
contribute.zh: 睡眠不足可能导致注意力不集中。

efficient.en: An efficient heating system uses less energy.
efficient.zh: 高效的供暖系统消耗更少的能源。
efficient.phrase: an efficient system · 高效的系统

expand.en: The university plans to expand its library next year.
expand.zh: 这所大学计划明年扩建图书馆。
expand.phrase: expand a library · 扩建图书馆

adapt.en: It can take time to adapt to life in a new country.
adapt.zh: 适应一个新国家的生活可能需要时间。

affect.en: A lack of natural light can affect people's mood.
affect.zh: 缺乏自然光会影响人们的情绪。
affect.phrase: affect people's mood · 影响人们的情绪

issue.en: Affordable housing is an important issue in many large cities.
issue.zh: 可负担住房是许多大城市面临的一个重要问题。
issue.phrase: an important issue · 重要问题

community.en: The new park has become a meeting place for the local community.
community.zh: 新公园已成为当地社区居民的聚会场所。
community.phrase: the local community · 当地社区
